items.title: The Newlywed Game Episode from 1972
items.description: Blocked on YouTube, posting to here. This is among a group of rare episodes from the original ABC Daytime era of "The Newlywed Game", and also the longest running of all incarnations on network, syndication or cable.

items.title: The New Newlywed Game- April 15, 1986
items.description: Here's a classic episode of the "New" Newlywed Game, complete with the original consolation prize and ticket plugs from 1986 (note that most, if not all episodes of this season were taped in 1985 as is typical for many syndicated game shows).

items.title: The New Newlywed Game episode, March 1986-F
items.description:
Another episode of The New Newlywed Game, taped in March 1986. Couples: Robin and Jack; Lee and Raywan; Shelley and Jim; Chris & Kim. Host: Bob Eubanks. No commercials, but this was taped off KAPP/35 Yakima as it was found at a local estate sale.
